Bihar minors harassed; 3 arrested after viral video sparks outrage

In Bihar's Jamui district, three individuals have been arrested following the circulation of a video showing minors being harassed and intimidated by a mob. The incident has triggered widespread outrage, prompting the formation of a Special Investigation Team (SIT) by the Bihar police. The National Commission for Women (NCW) has also taken cognisance of the matter. Police have identified seven perpetrators and vowed legal action. The coverage indicates the victims were teen female students.
